faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about my services and workflow.
faq.q1: What technologies do you use most often?
faq.a1: I frequently work with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for Frontend. For Backend, I am accustomed to using Node.js, Python (Flask), and PHP (Laravel). I am also proficient in Mobile development using Flutter.
faq.a2: Yes, I am open to freelance projects or long-term collaborations. Please feel free to contact me via the contact form on the main page or through email.
faq.q3: How long does it take to build a website?
faq.a3: The timeline depends highly on the complexity of the features. A simple profile website usually takes 1-2 weeks, while a more complex web application can take a month or more.
faq.a4: I am currently based in Tegal, Central Java, Indonesia. However, I am accustomed to working remotely with clients from anywhere.
